words.turkish_meaning: kabul etmek, itiraf etmek; hakkını teslim etmek
words.english_definition: to accept or admit the existence or truth of something
words.example_sentence: The government acknowledged the growing disparity in public healthcare access.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Hükümet, kamu sağlık hizmetlerine erişimdeki artan eşitsizliği kabul etti.

words.english_definition: to adjust to new conditions or modify for a new purpose
words.example_sentence: Organisms must rapidly adapt to altered climatic conditions to avoid extinction.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Organizmalar, yok olmaktan kaçınmak için değişen iklim koşullarına hızla uyum sağlamalıdır.

words.english_definition: satisfactory or acceptable in quality or quantity
words.example_sentence: Rural schools often lack adequate laboratory facilities for science education.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Kırsal okullar genellikle fen eğitimi için yeterli laboratuvar imkanlarından yoksundur.

words.english_definition: in a way that prevents success or development; harmfully
words.example_sentence: Prolonged exposure to heavy metals adversely affects human neural development.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Ağır metallere uzun süre maruz kalmak insan sinir gelişimini olumsuz biçimde etkiler.

words.english_definition: to change or cause to change in character or composition
words.example_sentence: Genetic mutations can radically alter the enzymatic pathway of cellular metabolism.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Genetik mutasyonlar, hücresel metabolizmanın enzimatik yolunu kökten değiştirebilir.

words.turkish_meaning: muğlak, belirsiz, birden fazla anlama gelebilen
words.english_definition: open to more than one interpretation; having a double meaning
words.example_sentence: The legal clause remained ambiguous regarding cross-border corporate liability.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Yasal madde, sınır ötesi şirket sorumluluğu konusunda muğlak kalmıştır.

words.english_definition: to regard as probable; expect or predict
words.example_sentence: Economists anticipate a modest recovery in quarterly manufacturing output.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Ekonomistler, üç aylık imalat üretiminde ılımlı bir toparlanma öngörüyor.

words.english_definition: clearly visible or understood; seeming rather than real
words.example_sentence: The apparent benefits of the policy masked significant underlying structural costs.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Politikanın görünürdeki faydaları, altta yatan önemli yapısal maliyetleri maskelemiştir.

words.english_definition: based on random choice or personal whim, rather than reason or system
words.example_sentence: The border restrictions appeared arbitrary and lacked clear epidemiological justification.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Sınır kısıtlamaları keyfi görünüyordu ve net bir epidemiyolojik gerekçeden yoksundu.

words.english_definition: to evaluate or estimate the nature, ability, or quality of
words.example_sentence: Psychologists designed a questionnaire to assess emotional resilience under workplace stress.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Psikologlar, iş yeri stresi altında duygusal dayanıklılığı değerlendirmek için bir anket tasarladı.

words.english_definition: to regard something as being caused by
words.example_sentence: Researchers attribute the rise in pediatric asthma to particulate atmospheric pollution.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Araştırmacılar, çocukluk çağı astımındaki artışı partikül hava kirliliğine bağlıyor.

words.english_definition: prejudice in favor of or against one thing, person, or group
words.example_sentence: Algorithmic bias in automated recruitment systems can perpetuate demographic discrimination.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Otomatik işe alım sistemlerindeki algoritmik yanlılık, demografik ayrımcılığı sürdürebilir.

words.english_definition: to help or encourage something to increase or improve
words.example_sentence: Moderate physical exercise is known to boost immunological defense mechanisms.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Ilımlı fiziksel egzersizin bağışıklık savunma mekanizmalarını artırdığı bilinmektedir.

words.english_definition: the maximum amount that something can contain or produce; mental or legal ability
words.example_sentence: The intensive care unit exceeded its operational capacity during the winter pandemic surge.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Yoğun bakım ünitesi, kış pandemisi dalgası sırasında operasyonel kapasitesini aştı.

words.english_definition: to make a statement or situation less confused and more comprehensible
words.example_sentence: The university senate issued a circular to clarify grading policies for online examinations.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Üniversite senatosu, çevrimiçi sınavlar için notlandırma politikalarını netleştirmek amacıyla bir genelge yayımladı.

words.english_definition: to occur at or during the same time; correspond in nature
words.example_sentence: The publication of the scientific thesis coincided with the international astronomy conference.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Bilimsel tezin yayımlanması, uluslararası astronomi konferansı ile aynı zamana denk geldi.

words.english_definition: to force or oblige someone to do something
words.example_sentence: Severe budget deficits compelled the hospital board to reduce surgical personnel.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Ciddi bütçe açıkları, hastane yönetim kurulunu cerrahi personeli azaltmaya zorladı.

words.english_definition: to grasp mentally; understand completely
words.example_sentence: Young children struggle to comprehend abstract cosmological dimensions of space-time.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Küçük çocuklar, uzay-zamanın soyut kozmolojik boyutlarını kavramakta zorlanırlar.

words.english_definition: complete; including all or nearly all elements or aspects
words.example_sentence: The medical team drafted a comprehensive diagnostic protocol for rare autoimmune syndromes.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Tıp ekibi, nadir otoimmün sendromlar için kapsamlı bir teşhis protokolü hazırladı.

words.english_definition: a result or effect, typically one that is unwelcome or unpleasant
words.example_sentence: Deforestation in upstream watersheds has dire consequences for downstream communities.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Yukarı su havzalarındaki ormansızlaşmanın, nehir aşağısındaki topluluklar için feci sonuçları vardır.

words.turkish_meaning: kayda değer, önemli miktarda, hatırı sayılır
words.english_definition: notably large in size, amount, or extent

words.example_sentence_turkish: Mühendislik ekibi, ısı yalıtımını optimize etmeye kayda değer miktarda enerji yatırdı.

words.english_definition: to severely restrict the scope, extent, or activity of
words.example_sentence: Inadequate computational hardware severely constrained the scope of artificial neural simulations.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Yetersiz bilgi işlem donanımı, yapay sinir simülasyonlarının kapsamını ciddi biçimde kısıtladı.

words.english_definition: giving rise or likely to give rise to public disagreement
words.example_sentence: The construction of the hydroelectric barrage on the cross-border river was highly controversial.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Sınır aşan nehir üzerindeki hidroelektrik barajının inşası son derece tartışmalıydı.

words.english_definition: based on or in accordance with what is generally done or believed
words.example_sentence: Conventional agricultural methods frequently rely on synthetic pesticides and mineral fertilizers.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Geleneksel tarım yöntemleri sıklıkla sentetik pestisitlere ve mineral gübrelere dayanır.

words.english_definition: decisive or critical, especially in the success or failure of something
words.example_sentence: Early antibiotic administration is crucial in halting the progression of septic infections.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Erken antibiyotik uygulaması, septik enfeksiyonların ilerlemesini durdurmada hayati öneme sahiptir.

words.english_definition: diminish in strength or quality; politely refuse
words.example_sentence: Endangered amphibian populations declined sharply following fungal pathogen outbreaks.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Nesli tükenmekte olan amfibi popülasyonları, mantar patojeni salgınlarının ardından keskin bir şekilde azaldı.

words.english_definition: consciously and intentionally; on purpose
words.example_sentence: The study group deliberately excluded patients taking concurrent corticosteroid medications.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Çalışma grubu, eşzamanlı kortikosteroid ilacı kullanan hastaları kasten hariç tuttu.

words.english_definition: to become progressively worse in quality or condition
words.example_sentence: If left untreated, chronic respiratory diseases can deteriorate into acute respiratory distress.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Tedavi edilmediği takdirde, kronik solunum yolu hastalıkları akut solunum sıkıntısına dönüşebilir.

words.english_definition: tending to cause harm or damage
words.example_sentence: Excessive sugar consumption has a documented detrimental effect on dental and arterial health.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Aşırı şeker tüketiminin diş ve damar sağlığı üzerinde belgelenmiş zararlı bir etkisi vardır.

words.english_definition: to make or become less
words.example_sentence: Advancements in satellite navigation did not diminish the captain's ultimate navigational responsibility.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Uydu navigasyonundaki gelişmeler, kaptanın nihai seyir sorumluluğunu azaltmadı.

words.english_definition: a lack of compatibility or similarity between two or more facts
words.example_sentence: Forensic auditors found an alarming discrepancy between reported revenues and bank deposits.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Adli denetçiler, bildirilen gelirler ile banka mevduatları arasında endişe verici bir tutarsızlık buldu.

words.english_definition: showing a great deal of variety; very different
words.example_sentence: Tropical coral reefs host a remarkably diverse assemblage of teleost marine fishes.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Tropikal mercan resifleri, dikkate değer derecede çeşitli bir kemikli deniz balığı topluluğuna ev sahipliği yapar.

words.english_definition: completely remove or get rid of
words.example_sentence: Modern sanitation initiatives helped eliminate cholera from municipal water supplies.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Modern sanitasyon girişimleri, koleranın kentsel su kaynaklarından yok edilmesine yardımcı oldu.

words.turkish_meaning: ortaya çıkmak, belirmek, gün yüzüne çıkmak
words.english_definition: to become apparent, important, or prominent
words.example_sentence: New antibiotic-resistant pathogens continue to emerge in intensive agricultural animal units.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Yoğun tarımsal hayvan ünitelerinde yeni antibiyotik dirençli patojenler ortaya çıkmaya devam ediyor.

words.english_definition: based on, concerned with, or verifiable by observation or experience rather than theory
words.example_sentence: The thesis provided robust empirical evidence to support quantum thermodynamic principles.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Tez, kuantum termodinamik ilkelerini desteklemek için sağlam deneysel kanıtlar sağladı.

words.english_definition: intensify, increase, or further improve the quality, value, or extent of
words.example_sentence: Adding organic biochar to sandy agricultural topsoil enhances moisture retention capacity.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Kumlu tarımsal üst toprağa organik biyokömür eklemek nem tutma kapasitesini artırır.

words.english_definition: set up on a firm or permanent basis; show to be true
words.example_sentence: Epidemiologists established a causal link between microparticulate smog and coronary thrombosis.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Epidemiyologlar, mikropartikül duman ile koroner tromboz arasında nedensel bir bağlantı kurdu.

words.english_definition: in the end, especially after a long delay, dispute, or series of problems
words.example_sentence: After decades of international diplomacy, opposing factions eventually signed the armistice.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Onlarca yıllık uluslararası diplomasinin ardından, karşıt gruplar nihayetinde ateşkesi imzaladı.

words.english_definition: the available body of facts or information indicating whether a belief is true
words.example_sentence: Paleontological evidence demonstrates that avian feathers originated for thermal regulation.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Paleontolojik kanıtlar, kuş tüylerinin termal düzenleme amacıyla ortaya çıktığını göstermektedir.

words.english_definition: make full use of and derive benefit from; use unfairly
words.example_sentence: Colonial powers historically exploited mineral wealth without developing local infrastructure.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Sömürgeci güçler, tarihsel olarak yerel altyapıyı geliştirmeden maden zenginliğini sömürdü.

words.english_definition: make an action or process easy or easier
words.example_sentence: Digital translation software facilitates interlingual communication across multinational supply chains.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Dijital çeviri yazılımları, çok uluslu tedarik zincirlerinde diller arası iletişimi kolaylaştırır.

words.english_definition: possible to do easily or conveniently
words.example_sentence: Transitioning entirely to renewable grid storage has become economically feasible.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Tamamen yenilenebilir şebeke depolamasına geçiş ekonomik olarak uygulanabilir hale gelmiştir.

words.english_definition: encourage or promote the development of something
words.example_sentence: Interdisciplinary seminars foster creative collaborative thinking among doctoral candidates.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Disiplinler arası seminerler, doktora adayları arasında yaratıcı işbirlikçi düşünmeyi teşvik eder.

words.english_definition: cause something to arise or come about; produce energy
words.example_sentence: Solar installations in desert basins generate enormous quantities of zero-emission electrical power.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Çöl havzalarındaki güneş enerjisi santralleri, muazzam miktarda sıfır emisyonlu elektrik enerjisi üretir.

words.english_definition: create difficulties for someone or something, resulting in delay or obstruction
words.example_sentence: Severe geopolitical friction hindered international cooperation during the climate negotiations.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Ciddi jeopolitik sürtüşmeler, iklim müzakereleri sırasında uluslararası işbirliğini engelledi.

words.english_definition: put a decision, plan, or agreement into effect
words.example_sentence: The municipal authority decided to implement automated congestion pricing downtown.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Belediye idaresi, şehir merkezinde otomatik trafik sıkışıklığı fiyatlandırmasını uygulamaya karar verdi.

words.english_definition: strongly suggest the truth or existence of something not explicitly stated
words.example_sentence: The geological survey findings imply that magma chambers are closer to the surface than previously estimated.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Jeolojik araştırma bulguları, magma odalarının daha önce tahmin edilenden yüzeye daha yakın olduğunu ima etmektedir.

words.english_definition: a thing that motivates or encourages someone to do something
words.example_sentence: Government subsidies provide a powerful financial incentive for manufacturers to adopt clean technology.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Hükümet sübvansiyonları, üreticilerin temiz teknolojiyi benimsemesi için güçlü bir mali teşvik sağlar.

words.english_definition: certain to happen; unavoidable
words.example_sentence: Without structural repairs, the eventual collapse of the century-old viaduct became inevitable.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Yapısal onarımlar olmadan, asırlık viyadüğün nihai çöküşü kaçınılmaz hale geldi.

words.turkish_meaning: doğasında olan, özünde var olan, fıtri
words.english_definition: existing in something as a permanent, essential, or characteristic attribute
words.example_sentence: There is an inherent trade-off between battery energy density and operational flammability.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Pil enerji yoğunluğu ile operasyonel alev alabilirlik arasında doğasında var olan bir denge vardır.

words.english_definition: hinder, restrain, or prevent an action or process
words.example_sentence: Certain pharmacological enzymes inhibit viral replication inside mammalian respiratory cells.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Bazı farmakolojik enzimler, memeli solunum hücrelerinin içinde viral replikasyonu engeller.

words.english_definition: an accurate and deep intuitive understanding of a person or thing

words.example_sentence_turkish: Karşılaştırmalı primatoloji, insan sözlü iletişiminin kökenlerine dair değerli içgörüler sağlar.

words.english_definition: combine one thing with another so that they become a whole

words.example_sentence_turkish: Otomotiv tasarımcıları, yapay zeka sensörlerini araç ön panellerine sorunsuz bir şekilde entegre etmeye çalışıyor.

words.english_definition: show or prove to be right or reasonable
words.example_sentence: The defense ministry struggled to justify the astronomical expenditure on hypersonic missiles.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Savunma bakanlığı, hipersonik füzelere yapılan astronomik harcamayı haklı çıkarmakta zorlandı.

words.english_definition: the great size or extent of something; brightness of a star; seismic intensity
words.example_sentence: Seismologists recorded an undersea earthquake of magnitude seven point eight on the Richter scale.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Sismologlar, Richter ölçeğinde yedi nokta sekiz büyüklüğünde bir denizaltı depremi kaydetti.

words.turkish_meaning: sürdürmek, devam ettirmek; bakımını yapmak; iddia etmek

words.example_sentence: Air traffic controllers must maintain heightened sensory vigilance throughout intense nocturnal shifts.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Hava trafik kontrolörleri, yoğun gece vardiyaları boyunca yüksek duyusal teyakkuzlarını sürdürmelidir.

words.english_definition: a natural or established process by which something takes place or is brought about
words.example_sentence: Researchers isolated the exact biochemical mechanism responsible for hereditary hair follicle miniaturization.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Araştırmacılar, kalıtsal saç folikülü minyatürleşmesinden sorumlu kesin biyokimyasal mekanizmayı izole etti.

words.english_definition: make less severe, serious, or painful
words.example_sentence: Urban reforestation initiatives help mitigate destructive heat island microclimates.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Kentsel yeniden ağaçlandırma girişimleri, yıkıcı ısı adası mikro iklimlerini hafifletmeye yardımcı olur.

words.english_definition: continuing firmly or obstinately in a course of action; continuing to exist over a prolonged period

words.english_definition: a fact or situation that is observed to exist or happen, especially one whose cause is in question
words.example_sentence: Bioluminescence is an enchanting biological phenomenon observed primarily in abyssal marine fauna.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Biyolüminesans, öncelikle derin deniz faunasında gözlemlenen büyüleyici bir biyolojik olgudur.

words.english_definition: the fact or condition of being widespread or common
words.example_sentence: The prevalence of childhood obesity has escalated markedly in industrialized metropolitan centers.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Çocukluk çağı obezitesinin yaygınlığı, sanayileşmiş metropol merkezlerinde belirgin şekilde arttı.

words.english_definition: very great or intense; having or showing great knowledge or insight
words.example_sentence: The advent of genetic engineering promises to exert a profound influence on agriculture and medicine.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Genetik mühendisliğinin ortaya çıkışı, tarım ve tıp üzerinde derin bir etki yaratmayı vaat ediyor.

words.english_definition: strengthen or support, especially with additional personnel or material
words.example_sentence: Recent archaeological dating reinforced the proposition that maritime navigation predated urban settlement.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Son arkeolojik tarihlendirmeler, denizcilik navigasyonunun kentsel yerleşimden önce geldiği önermesini pekiştirdi.

words.english_definition: unwilling and hesitant; disinclined
words.example_sentence: Venture capital funds were reluctant to invest in unproven deep-space mining ventures.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Girişim sermayesi fonları, kanıtlanmamış derin uzay madenciliği girişimlerine yatırım yapmakta isteksizdi.

words.english_definition: have a similar appearance to or qualities in common with
words.example_sentence: Extraterrestrial rock fragments retrieved from the asteroid closely resemble primitive carbonaceous chondrites.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Asteroitten alınan dünya dışı kaya parçaları, ilkel karbonlu kondritlere çok benzemektedir.

words.english_definition: continue to have; keep possession of
words.example_sentence: Despite extensive thermal sterilization, the medicinal herbal extract retained its antimicrobial potency.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Kapsamlı termal sterilizasyona rağmen, tıbbi bitkisel öz antimikrobiyal gücünü korumuştur.

words.turkish_meaning: ortaya çıkarmak, ifşa etmek, gözler önüne sermek

words.example_sentence_turkish: Kızılötesi teleskop araştırmaları, kozmik tozun arkasında daha önce tespit edilmemiş yüzlerce cüce galaksiyi ortaya çıkardı.

words.english_definition: the state of being scarce or in short supply; shortage

words.example_sentence_turkish: Şiddetli yer altı suyu kıtlığı, iç plato topluluklarının tarımsal geçim kaynaklarını tehdit ediyor.

words.english_definition: originate in or be caused by; stop the flow of

words.english_definition: of considerable importance, size, or worth
words.example_sentence: The government provided substantial grants to laboratories researching synthetic hydrogen fuel cells.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Hükümet, sentetik hidrojen yakıt hücrelerini araştıran laboratuvarlara önemli miktarda hibe sağladı.

words.english_definition: able to be maintained at a certain rate or level; not harmful to the environment
words.example_sentence: Sustainable urban development necessitates transitioning toward fully electrified mass transit grids.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Sürdürülebilir kentsel gelişim, tamamen elektrikli toplu taşıma şebekelerine geçişi gerektirir.

words.english_definition: an inclination toward a particular characteristic or type of behavior
words.example_sentence: Financial markets exhibit a pronounced tendency to overreact to short-term political announcements.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Finans piyasaları, kısa vadeli siyasi duyurulara aşırı tepki verme konusunda belirgin bir eğilim sergiler.

words.english_definition: cause an event or situation to happen or exist
words.example_sentence: Sudden seismic shifts along oceanic trenches trigger destructive tsunamis across coastal basins.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Okyanus hendekleri boyunca meydana gelen ani sismik kaymalar, kıyı havzalarında yıkıcı tsunamileri tetikler.

words.english_definition: estimate something to be smaller or less important than it actually is

words.english_definition: experience or be subjected to something, typically unpleasant or difficult
words.example_sentence: The historic cathedral will undergo structural reinforcement to protect against seismic tremors.
words.example_sentence_turkish: Tarihi katedral, sismik sarsıntılara karşı korunmak için yapısal güçlendirmeden geçecek.

words.english_definition: susceptible to physical or emotional attack or harm

words.example_sentence_turkish: Bebekler ve yaşlı nüfus, şiddetli mevsimsel viral patojenlere karşı son derece savunmasızdır.
